own_solution.law: Newton's second law a = F_net / m_A
assumptions: the stated 10.0 N is the net horizontal force on A
block B has no physical interaction with A

notes: Authors' equation a = F_net/m_A, parameters (10.0 N, 2.0 kg) and certified answer 5.0 m/s^2 agree with my pass-1 solution. m_B is absent from the governing relation and the text rules out any interaction, so the invariance across the four renderings holds. Renderings differ only in m_B. No disagreement with pass 1.
